_comment: MANIFEST-style expected contradiction findings fixture for Pillar 4 (Cross-Layer Contradiction Detection) under testdata/contradictions. Consumed by tests/golden/test_contradictions_golden.py.

scenarios.name: scenario1_conflict
scenarios.description: Python source code enforces TLS 1.3 minimum, but co-located nginx.conf permits TLSv1 and TLSv1.1 (genuine cross-layer contradiction).

scenarios.name: scenario2_matching
scenarios.description: Python source code enforces TLS 1.3 minimum and co-located nginx.conf permits only TLSv1.3 (aligned policies, no contradiction).

scenarios.name: scenario3_config_only
scenarios.description: nginx.conf permits legacy TLS, but no source file exists in the scope (config finding emitted, but no contradiction).
